description: Lane × winning thumbnail-text-format matrix. Use to pick the right thumb style for a given title. UPDATED 2026-05-17 with Tests 15-18 — sleep no longer 'tolerant' (Test 16 overturned Test 10); cognitive_clarity lane added (Test 17 63/37 decisive).
rule_for_refresh_batches: Mix formats across batch — don't ship 4 Q-hooks in a row (channel-page pattern blindness). 2 Q-hook + 2 outcome-imperative is healthy ratio for a 4-refresh batch.

pairing_convention.rule: Matched-pair A/B: If title is SEO/statement → use Q-hook thumb. If title is Q-hook → use outcome-imperative thumb.
pairing_convention.rationale: Preserves test power — never both Q, never both statement

focus.evidence: A/B Test 6: BOOST YOUR FOCUS beat NEED ENERGY RESET? 73/27

calm.evidence: A/B Test 2: SEO Calm Your Mind beat Q-hook Feeling Lost? 68/32

healing.evidence: A/B Test 12 running: EMOTIONAL HEALING leading HEAL YOUR HEART 52/48; Test 7 tied
healing.note: Lane is THUMB-FORMAT TOLERANT — Q-hooks tied in Test 7. Abstract-noun edges imperative.

stress_burnout.evidence: A/B Test 13 running: REST. RESET. RECOVER. leading BURNOUT? 51/49

anxiety_overthinking.evidence: A/B Test 9: TOO MANY THOUGHTS? beat THINK LESS
losers: THINK LESS (imperative — lost to TOO MANY THOUGHTS)
anxiety_overthinking.note: The ONLY lane where Q-hook thumbs decisively win

morning_practice.evidence: A/B Test 14: CALM MORNING VIBES beat MORNING PEACE 59/41

sleep.evidence: A/B Test 16 (May 14): DRIFT TO SLEEP outcome-imperative beat DEEPLY DRAINED? Q-hook 55/45. Overturns earlier Test 10 'tie' interpretation. Test 16 paired with Insomnia Relief Music lead vs Sound Sleep — outcome+clinical-lead combo wins.
sleep.note: Test 10 said 'tied' but Test 16 with proper clinical-state lead crystallized that sleep lane wants imperative thumbs. Q-hook recognizes the problem; imperative promises the resolution (which is what sleep audience clicks for).

cognitive_clarity.evidence: A/B Test 17 (May 15-): MENTALLY EXHAUSTED? Q-hook + SEO-led title beat RESET YOUR THOUGHTS statement + Q-lead title 63/37 (26.4pp gap — biggest ever).
cognitive_clarity.note: Brain Fog / cognitive-reset / mental clarity audience wants viewer-state recognition (Q-hook), not promised outcome. Tightest clinical-curiosity lane.

relaxation_evening.evidence: A/B Test 15 (May 5, thumb-only test with identical titles): STRESSED? Q-hook beat RELAX DEEPLY outcome-imperative 55/45 (10.4pp). Pure thumb-format isolation.
relaxation_evening.note: Evening relaxation/wind-down audience responds to state-recognition Q-hooks, not action verbs.

uplifting.evidence: Inferred from Test 14 cross-lane (vibes beat affect in morning)

thumb_format_definitions.outcome_imperative: Action verb directing viewer to outcome state — 'BOOST FOCUS', 'LOCK IN'
thumb_format_definitions.outcome_state: Noun phrase naming the desired state — 'FIND PEACE', 'QUIET MIND'
thumb_format_definitions.tolerant: Multiple formats work — lane is forgiving
